# Configuration reference — `mesh.yaml`

Every field of `~/.mnemos/mesh.yaml`, with type, default, and
description. Field names follow `internal/config/config.go`; the
loader applies defaults, then a basic structural check (M2 scope).
Full schema validation (ACL shapes, fingerprint format, dial
timeouts) lands in M5.

> **Audience:** operators writing `mesh.yaml`. For a guided first
> run, see [getting-started.md](mnemos-mesh/user/getting-started).

---

## File location

| Default | Override |
|---|---|
| `~/.mnemos/mesh.yaml` | `mnemos-mesh serve --config PATH` |

If `--config` is empty, the loader resolves `~/.mnemos/mesh.yaml`.

---

## Top-level fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node_id` | string | *(required)* | This node's peer id. Binds to the mTLS cert CN (criterion 3, architecture §7). Used as `peer_id` in ACL lookup and `federation_access_log`. Empty → `ErrEmptyNodeID`. |
| `listen` | string | `:8443` | Peer gRPC (mTLS) listen address, `host:port`. |
| `unix_socket` | string | `/run/mnemos/core.sock` | Mesh↔mnemos Unix socket path. The mesh creates the socket; mnemos dials it. |
| `mtls` | object | *(required)* | mTLS settings — see below. |
| `peers` | list | `[]` | Peer registry — see below. |
| `mnemos` | object | *(defaults)* | Mesh→mnemos dial behaviour — see below. |
| `logging` | object | `info` / `json` | Structured log level + format — see below. |
| `metrics` | object | *(empty)* | Optional Prometheus scrape listener — see below. |

---

## `mtls`

Private-CA + pinned-fingerprint mTLS settings (criterion 3).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ca_cert` | string | *(required)* | Path to the private CA certificate PEM. Added to the client CA pool; `ClientAuth = RequireAndVerifyClientCert`. Empty → `ErrNoMTLSCerts`. |
| `node_cert` | string | *(required)* | Path to this node's mTLS client+server cert PEM. CN **must** match `node_id`. |
| `node_key` | string | *(required)* | Path to this node's mTLS private key PEM. |
| `peer_fingerprints` | map[string]string | `nil` | Pinned peer fingerprints, `peer_id → "sha256:<hex>"`. The mTLS listener verifies each connecting peer's cert against this map **after** CA validation (defence against a compromised CA). Empty = CA validation only (some M2 tests). Malformed entries → `ErrFingerprintFormat` at startup. |
| `rotation_days` | int | `90` | Cert rotation cadence (days). M2 reads it but does not act — rotation lands in M5. |

### Fingerprint format

```text
sha256:<lowercase-hex>
```

Compute with:

```bash
openssl x509 -in node.pem -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/://g'
```

Strip colons and the `sha256 Fingerprint=` prefix, then prefix with
`sha256:`. The loader lowercases the hex.

---

## `peers[]`

The peer registry. Each entry describes one remote mesh peer.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | *(required)* | Peer's A2A id; matches the cert CN binding. |
| `address` | string | *(required)* | Peer mesh's mTLS gRPC listen address, `host:port`. |
| `fingerprint` | string | `""` | Pinned peer cert fingerprint (`sha256:<hex>`). Optional at config-load time (M5 validates format); M2 mTLS uses `mtls.peer_fingerprints` for the actual pinning check. |
| `projects` | list[string] | `[]` | Per-peer ACL — allowed project scopes. **Carried** by the mesh in RPC requests; **enforced** by mnemos as a GATE (criterion 5). The mesh does NOT inspect content to enforce ACL. |

> **ACL is mnemos-side.** The mesh carries `peer_id` + `project_scope`
> and request filters in the RPC; mnemos checks them against its per-peer
> config before returning any record. Do NOT implement ACL enforcement in
> the mesh — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Korrnals/mnemos-mesh/blob/331ef3a785c1a74fb9f8972ff93cd6db5a8fc174/CONTRIBUTING.md) hard rule 4.

---

## `mnemos`

Mesh→mnemos core channel (W2.5: transport-selectable, ADR-0019
option 1).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transport` | string | `unix` | Core-leg transport: `unix` (same-host AF_UNIX socket at `unix_socket`) or `tcp` (networked gRPC+mTLS). Explicit choice — **no auto-fallback**. |
| `address` | string | `""` | Required for `transport: tcp` — the core gRPC host:port (mnemos-core port 8790; Phase-1 sidecar binds `127.0.0.1`). Rejected on the unix leg. |
| `core_fingerprint` | string | `""` | Optional (`tcp` only): pin the core server cert, `sha256:<64 hex>` — a tightening on top of the mandatory mesh-CA chain validation. Rejected on the unix leg. |
| `dial_timeout` | duration | `2s` | Timeout for establishing the connection to local mnemos (Unix socket or TCP, per `transport`). |
| `heartbeat_interval` | duration | `30s` | Cadence of `Heartbeat` probes. M2 reads it but does not schedule heartbeats yet (M3+). |

On the tcp leg the mesh presents its `mtls.node_cert` and verifies
the core server cert against `mtls.ca_cert` — the same trust material
as the peer leg. `doctor` and `/healthz` probe the configured leg.

Durations are Go `time.Duration` strings: `2s`, `30s`, `1m`, `500ms`.

---

## `logging`

Structured log level + format.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | string | `info` | Log level. M2 accepts `debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error`. |
| `format` | string | `json` | Log format. M2 supports `json`; `text` is planned for M5. |

---

## `metrics`

Optional Prometheus-style scrape listener.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listen` | string | `""` | Scrape listen address, `host:port`. Empty = disabled. Default example: `127.0.0.1:9100`. |

M2 exposes no metrics yet — the listener is wired in M5 (production
hardening).

---

## Defaults

Applied when fields are omitted. The loader fills defaults **before**
the structural check, so an empty file still fails on `node_id` and
mTLS material paths.

```go
Listen:     ":8443"
UnixSocket: "/run/mnemos/core.sock"
Logging:    {Level: "info", Format: "json"}
Mnemos:     {DialTimeout: 2s, HeartbeatInterval: 30s}
MTLS:       {RotationDays: 90}
```

---

## Structural checks (M2 scope)

The loader performs the minimum structural rules the stub needs to
start. Full validation (ACL shapes, fingerprint format, peer
reachability) is deferred to M5.

| Check | Error if failed |
|---|---|
| `node_id` non-empty | `ErrEmptyNodeID` |
| `mtls.{ca_cert, node_cert, node_key}` present | `ErrNoMTLSCerts` |
| `listen` non-empty (defaults to `:8443`) | filled |
| `unix_socket` non-empty (defaults to `/run/mnemos/core.sock`) | filled |
| `mnemos.dial_timeout` non-zero (defaults `2s`) | filled |
| `mnemos.heartbeat_interval` non-zero (defaults `30s`) | filled |

### Peer lookup

`cfg.PeerByID(id string) *Peer` — returns the configured peer by id,
or `nil` if not found. Used by the FederationPeer server to resolve
the connecting peer's ACL fields.

---

## Full example

```yaml
# ~/.mnemos/mesh.yaml — per-node mesh configuration
node_id: mnemos-A
listen: 0.0.0.0:8443
unix_socket: /run/mnemos/core.sock

mtls:
  ca_cert: /etc/mnemos-mesh/ca.pem
  node_cert: /etc/mnemos-mesh/node.pem
  node_key: /etc/mnemos-mesh/node.key
  peer_fingerprints:
    mnemos-B: sha256:abcdef0123456789...
  rotation_days: 90

peers:
  - id: mnemos-B
    address: b.example.invalid:8443
    fingerprint: sha256:abcdef0123456789...
    projects: ["project-mnemos"]

mnemos:
  dial_timeout: 2s
  heartbeat_interval: 30s

logging:
  level: info
  format: json

metrics:
  listen: 127.0.0.1:9100
```
